feudalism.definitionKo: 계급이 높은 사람이 권력을 가지고 계급이 낮은 사람을 종속시켜 다스리는 봉건 사회의 지배 이념.
feudalism.englishDescription: The domination ideology of feudal society, by which low-class people are subordinate to and controlled by high-class people with authority.

feudalism.definitionKo: (옛날에) 군주와 제후 사이의 주종 관계를 바탕으로 했던 정치 제도.
feudalism.englishDescription: (archaic) A political system based on a master-servant relationship between a monarch and feudal lords.

fibrin.definitionKo: 식물에서 얻는 섬유의 주된 성분인 흰 탄수화물.
fibrin.englishDescription: White carbohydrate which is the main component of the fiber gained from plants.

figure-skating.definitionKo: 스케이트를 타고 얼음판 위에서 여러 가지 동작을 하여 기술의 정확성과 예술성을 겨루는 운동.
figure-skating.englishDescription: A sport in which athletes make various movements to compete for accurate technique and artistic beauty, wearing a pair of ice skates on an ice rink.

flirt.englishDescription: To manipulate someone to use him/her at will.

fluff.definitionKo: 종이나 헝겊의 겉에 일어나는 가느다란 털.
fluff.englishDescription: A lump of thin threads on the surface of paper or cloth.

fluff.definitionKo: 식물의 꽃잎이나 잎 등에 있는 작고 가는 실 모양의 물질.
fluff.englishDescription: A small, thin thread-like substance found in the petals or leaves of plants.

fluff.definitionKo: 물건의 거죽에 부풀어 일어난 가는 실 모양의 물질.
fluff.englishDescription: A thin thread-like substance that swells up on the surface of an object.
To spread cotton using a willowing machine.

fluff.definitionKo: 종이나 헝겊의 겉에 일어나는 가느다란 털.
fluff.englishDescription: A lump of thin threads on the surface of paper or cloth.

fog.definitionKo: 땅 가까이에서 수증기가 뭉쳐 아주 작은 물방울들이 부옇게 떠 있는 현상.
fog.englishDescription: The phenomenon where water vapor comes together to form tiny, misty droplets that float close to the ground.

footmark.definitionKo: 발로 밟은 자리에 남은 발의 자국.
footmark.englishDescription: A mark on the ground, left by a foot or shoe.

fortieth.englishDescription: Constituting number forty in a series.

forwarder.definitionKo: 물건을 실어 나름. 또는 그런 회사.
forwarder.englishDescription: An act of carrying cargo, or a company providing such a service.

fountain.definitionKo: 흔히 공원이나 광장 한가운데에 설치하는, 좁은 구멍을 통해서 물을 위로 내뿜는 장치. 또는 그 물.
fountain.englishDescription: A structure installed usually in the middle of a park or square, which spurts water through small holes; water spurted in the structure.

fountain.definitionKo: 좁은 구멍을 통해서 물을 위로 내뿜도록 만들어 놓은 시설.
fountain.englishDescription: A structure installed to spurt up water through small holes.

fountain.definitionKo: 샘물이 솟아 나오는 곳. 또는 그 주변.
fountain.englishDescription: A place where spring water gushes out, or its surroundings.
(figurative) A place from which spring water gushes out, or its surroundings.

freezing.definitionKo: 식어서 차게 됨. 또는 식혀서 차게 함.
freezing.englishDescription: The state of getting cool and then cold or frozen; the act of cooling and then freezing something.

freezing.definitionKo: 생선이나 고기 등을 상하지 않도록 보관하기 위해 얼림.
freezing.englishDescription: Refrigeration of fish or meat, etc., to prevent them from being spoiled.

futility.definitionKo: 가치 없고 의미 없게 느껴져 매우 허전하고 쓸쓸함.
futility.englishDescription: A state of thinking of something as worthless and meaningless, making one feel extremely empty and lonely.

futility.definitionKo: 가치 없고 의미 없게 느껴져 매우 허전하고 쓸쓸한 느낌.
futility.englishDescription: A state of finding something worthless and meaningless, feeling extremely empty and lonely.
A state of being absurd and fruitless.

gaebi.definitionKo: 가늘고 짤막하게 만든 물건을 세는 단위.
gaebi.englishDescription: The unit for counting short, uniformly narrow objects.

gain.definitionKo: 큰 현상이나 일, 목적 등을 이루다.
gain.englishDescription: To bring about a great phenomenon, finish work successfully, or realize an aim, etc.
To make positive progress or achieve good results.
To make positive progress or achieve good results.
The profits earned as a result of doing something.

gain.definitionKo: 내기, 경기 등에서 이겨 돈이나 점수, 상품 등을 얻어 내다.
gain.englishDescription: To obtain money, a good score, a gift, etc., by winning a game, while gambling, etc.

gain.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 당하거나 겪거나 얻어 가지다.
gain.englishDescription: To suffer, experience or gain something.
To obtain or receive a qualification or grade.
For a body or something similar to become fleshier.
The act of making a profit; the profit.

gain.definitionKo: 벌어들인 돈에서 순전히 이익으로 남은 돈.
gain.englishDescription: A sum of money that accounts for a net profit out of one's income.

gain.definitionKo: 긍정적인 태도나 반응, 상태 등을 가지거나 누리게 되다.
gain.englishDescription: To come to have or enjoy a positive attitude, response, state, etc.
To fight for and get what one wants.
To gain something such as income.
An act of increasing the amount of money, or an increased amount of money.

gangsin.definitionKo: 제사를 지내는 절차의 하나로 처음에 향을 피우고 술을 잔에 따라 붓는 일.
gangsin.englishDescription: One of the processes of a memorial ceremony, in which incense is burned and a drink is poured in a glass.

gangsin.definitionKo: 기도나 주문으로 신을 초대하여 자기 몸 안에 내리게 함.
gangsin.englishDescription: Inviting and receiving a spirit in one's body, with a spell or prayer.

garment.definitionKo: 사람의 몸을 가리고 더위나 추위 등으로부터 보호하며 멋을 내기 위하여 입는 것.
garment.englishDescription: An item that one wears to cover his/her body, protect himself/herself from cold, heat, etc., and look fashionable.

garment.definitionKo: 사람의 몸을 가리고 더위나 추위 등으로부터 보호하며 멋을 내기 위하여 입는 것.
garment.englishDescription: An item that one wears to cover his/her body, protect himself/herself from cold, heat, etc., and look fashionable.

garment.definitionKo: (옛날에) 신분이나 직업에 따라 달리 입던 옷의 모양이나 색.
garment.englishDescription: (archaic) The form or color of clothing that used to vary by the wearer's status or occupation.
The form or color of clothes.
An item that one wears to cover one's body.

garment.definitionKo: 사람의 몸을 가리고 더위나 추위 등으로부터 보호하며 멋을 내기 위하여 입는 것.
garment.englishDescription: An item that one wears to cover one's body, protect oneself from cold, heat, etc., and look fashionable.

gauntly.englishDescription: In the state of being very thin.
In the state of being too thin due to weight loss.

giveaway.definitionKo: 상품에 곁들여 고객에게 공짜로 주는 물건.
giveaway.englishDescription: A free item given to a customer for a product he/she has bought.

giwa.definitionKo: 흙이나 시멘트, 금속 등의 재료를 사용하여 넓적하게 만들어서 지붕을 덮는 데 쓰는 물건.
giwa.englishDescription: Wide, flat objects that are made from materials such as clay, cement, metal, etc., to be used for covering roofs.

goreum.definitionKo: 한복 저고리나 두루마기의 양쪽 앞부분에 달려 있어 옷이 벌어지지 않도록 묶는 끈.
goreum.englishDescription: Strips attached to a jeogori or durumagi, traditional Korean upper garments, to fasten both ends of its collar together.

grown-up.englishDescription: A person who is an adult.
A being that has certain qualifications and character.

gruff.englishDescription: One's voice being rough and deep.

guideline.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 나아갈 방향을 가리켜 주거나 목적을 이룰 수 있도록 이끌어 주는 것.
guideline.englishDescription: (figurative) Something that shows the direction to go or  helps achieve a goal.

guideline.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 행동 등의 방향이나 방법을 알려 주는 규칙이나 법칙.
guideline.englishDescription: A rule or principle that offers directions or methods for doing something.

habituated.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 자주 보거나 겪어서 낯설지 않고 편하다.
habituated.englishDescription: Not unfamiliar but comfortable with someone or something because one has seen him/her or experienced it often.

haggle.definitionKo: 물건을 사거나 팔기 위해 품질이나 가격 등을 의논하다.
haggle.englishDescription: To discuss quality, price, etc., to buy or sell products.

handstand.definitionKo: 손으로 바닥을 짚고 몸을 거꾸로 세우는 동작.
handstand.englishDescription: The act of balancing on the hands and standing upside down.

heckler.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 일이 제대로 되지 않게 간섭하고 막는 사람.
heckler.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person who interferes and obstructs to make things not go well.

heungbujeon.definitionKo: 조선 시대의 소설. 지은이와 지어진 시기는 알 수 없다. 심술궂고 욕심 많은 형 놀부와 마음씨 착한 동생 흥부에 관한 이야기로 형제간의 우애와 선악의 문제를 다루었다.
heungbujeon.englishDescription: tale of Heungbu: A novel in the Joseon Dynasty, whose time of writing and author are unknown;  the story is about a mean and greey person, Nolbu, and his kind-hearted younger brother, Heungbu, focusing on the themes of brotherly love and the contrast of good and evil.

hey.definitionKo: 남에게 말을 걸거나 주의를 끌 때, 말에 앞서 내는 소리.
hey.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered before the speaker begins his/her words when he/she talks to someone or attracts someone's attention.

hey.definitionKo: 어른이 아이를 부르거나 나이가 비슷한 사람들이 서로를 부르는 말.
hey.englishDescription: An exclamation used when an adult calls out to a child, or when persons of similar age call out to each other.

hey.definitionKo: 어른이 가까이에 있는 비슷한 나이의 사람을 부르는 말.
hey.englishDescription: A word used by an adult to address someone of similar age close to him/her.
An exclamation uttered when the speaker is surprised or exhilarated.

hey.definitionKo: 어른이 아이를 부르거나 나이가 비슷한 사람들이 서로를 부르는 말.
hey.englishDescription: A word used by an adult to refer to or address a child, or used by one to refer to or address others of similar age.

hey.definitionKo: 아이들이나 아랫사람에게 비키거나 그만두라는 뜻으로 내는 소리.
hey.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker tells children or someone who is junior to him/her, to move out of the way or stop doing something.

hey.definitionKo: 가까이에 있는, 약간 대우하며 낮추는 사람을 부를 때 쓰는 말.
hey.englishDescription: An exclamation used to address an inferior person who is nearby, in a manner of being slightly honorific.

hey.definitionKo: 또래나 아랫사람을 부를 때 쓰는 말.
hey.englishDescription: An exclamation used to call someone who is of the same age as the speaker is or is junior to the speaker.

housewife.definitionKo: 한 가정의 살림을 맡아서 하는 사람.
housewife.englishDescription: A married woman who manages a household.

housewife.definitionKo: 다른 직업은 갖지 않고 집안일만 전문으로 하는 주부.
housewife.englishDescription: A married woman who manages the household only and does not hold another occupation.

hyperstress.definitionKo: 더할 수 없을 정도로 매우 긴장함.
hyperstress.englishDescription: The state of being extremely tense.

ideality.definitionKo: 철학에서, 현실적이지 않고 추상적인 경향을 가지는 성질.
ideality.englishDescription: In philosophy, a quality that tends to be abstract rather than realistic.

idler.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 직업이 없이 빈둥거리며 막 사는 사내.
idler.englishDescription: (disparaging) A man who lives thoughtlessly, idling without a job.

immaculate.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 있어서 매우 조심하여 부족함이 없이 완벽하다.
immaculate.englishDescription: Being complete without flaws because one is very careful about something.
Being complete without flaws or defects.

immersion.englishDescription: The state of concentrating on something.

immersion.definitionKo: 다른 일에 관심을 가지지 않고 한 가지 일에만 집중하여 깊이 빠짐.
immersion.englishDescription: An act of focusing solely on one thing, being deeply involved in it without paying any attention to other affairs.

implant.definitionKo: 문제가 생긴 치아를 뽑아낸 자리에 인공 치아를 만들어 넣는 일.
implant.englishDescription: The process of creating an artificial tooth in the place where a problematic tooth was extracted.

implant.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 생각이나 감정을 마음속에 자리 잡게 하다.
implant.englishDescription: (figurative) To put a certain thought or feeling in someone's mind.

implant.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 사회에 새로운 사상이나 문화를 전해 깊이 자리 잡게 하다.
implant.englishDescription: (figurative) To introduce a new ideology or culture to a society and make it deeply rooted in it.

implant.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 일정한 대상이나 틀에 꽂아 넣다.
implant.englishDescription: To stick something into a certain space or something else.

implant.definitionKo: 수정이 이루어진 난자가 자궁벽 안쪽에 붙어 어미의 몸으로부터 영양을 흡수할 수 있는 상태가 되다.
implant.englishDescription: For a fertilized egg to attach itself to the lining of the uterus and grow properly so that it can absorb nutrition from the mother's body.

income.definitionKo: 일정 기간 동안에 정해진 일을 하고 그 대가로 받는 수입.
income.englishDescription: Money paid in return for doing a certain task during a certain period.

income.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하여 돈이나 물건 등을 거두어들임. 또는 그 돈이나 물건.

Money that an individual, nation, or organization earns.

inconsistency.definitionKo: 어떤 사실의 앞뒤, 또는 두 사실이 서로 어긋나 이치에 맞지 않는 성질.
inconsistency.englishDescription: The quality of a fact being illogical, or two facts being contrary so that they are incompatible.

The state of being opposite each other and being in contradiction.

inconstant.definitionKo: 말이나 행동, 감정 등이 이랬다저랬다 자주 변하는 데가 있다.
inconstant.englishDescription: Words, behavior, feelings, etc., often changing capriciously.

inconstant.definitionKo: 말이나 행동, 감정 등이 이랬다저랬다 자주 변하는 데가 있다.
inconstant.englishDescription: Words, behavior, feelings, etc., often changing capriciously.

indication.englishDescription: The act of pointing at something to make others look at it.

indication.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 꼭 집어서 분명하게 가리킴.
indication.englishDescription: The act of singling out or pointing out someone or something.

indication.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 현상 등이 일어나는 것을 짐작할 수 있게 해 주는 눈치나 분위기.
indication.englishDescription: General atmosphere or a sense of things by which it is possible to predict future behavior or phenomena.

indication.definitionKo: 어떤 사항을 알리는 내용을 겉에 드러내 보임.
indication.englishDescription: An act of displaying the content of a notice or an instruction on the surface of something.

indication.definitionKo: 어떠한 사실이나 사건을 증명하거나 증거가 되는 표.
indication.englishDescription: Something that proves a fact or event, or serves as evidence.

indirectly.englishDescription: By implication so that one's intention is not known directly.

indirectly.definitionKo: 듣는 사람의 기분이 상하지 않도록 말하는 투가 부드럽게.
indirectly.englishDescription: In a manner of speaking tactfully so that the listener will not be hurt.

inevitably.definitionKo: 현재의 상태를 벗어날 방법이 전혀 없이.
inevitably.englishDescription: Without any method to get out of the current situation.

inevitably.definitionKo: 마음이 내키지 않지만 하지 않을 수 없어 어쩔 수 없이.
inevitably.englishDescription: Because one has no choice but to do something although one is reluctant.

inevitably.definitionKo: 마음이 내키지는 않지만 어쩔 수 없이.
inevitably.englishDescription: With no other options despite one's reluctance.

inevitably.definitionKo: 마음이 내키지 않지만 하지 않을 수 없어 어쩔 수 없이.
inevitably.englishDescription: Because one has no choice but to do something although one is reluctant.

inevitably.definitionKo: 이미 정해진 것처럼 어쩔 수 없이.
inevitably.englishDescription: With no other options like something that is already determined.

instill.definitionKo: 어떤 생각이나 느낌을 가지도록 영향이나 자극을 주다.
instill.englishDescription: To stimulate or influence someone to have a certain idea or feeling.

instill.definitionKo: 사상이나 버릇 등을 다른 사람에게 전하거나 심어 주다.
instill.englishDescription: To transmit or implant a certain thought, habit, etc., to someone.

intention.englishDescription: An intention or will to do something.

intention.englishDescription: An act of planning and thinking carefully of things to do in the future; or such a thought.

intention.definitionKo: 마음이 끌리는 방향이나 어떤 일을 하려는 생각.
intention.englishDescription: A direction in which one's mind is attracted, or a thought to do something.

One's will or intention to do something.

interior.englishDescription: The inner space of an object.

interior.definitionKo: 거죽이나 껍질로 싸인 물체의 안쪽 부분.
interior.englishDescription: The inside part of an object that is covered with a coat or skin.

ironsmith.definitionKo: 쇠를 다루어서 기구를 만드는 일. 또는 그런 일을 직업으로 하는 사람.
ironsmith.englishDescription: An act of making iron articles, or a person who is employed in such field of work.

itchy.englishDescription: Feeling like to scratch one's skin.

itchy.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분이 가려운 느낌이 있다.
itchy.englishDescription: Having an itchy feeling on one's body.

itchy.definitionKo: 피부에 벌레가 기어다니는 것처럼 자꾸 근지러운 모양.
itchy.englishDescription: In a manner that one's skin itches as if insects are crawling on it.

ivory.definitionKo: 코끼리의 입 밖으로 길고 날카롭게 뻗어 있는 두 개의 앞니.
ivory.englishDescription: Two long and pointed front teeth that extend out from the mouth of an elephant.

ivory.definitionKo: 코끼리의 긴 앞니의 빛깔과 같이 하얀색 빛을 띤 노랑.
ivory.englishDescription: A yellow with a whitish tint, like the color of an elephant's long front teeth.

ivory.definitionKo: 코끼리의 긴 앞니의 빛깔과 같이 하얀색 빛을 띤 노랑.
ivory.englishDescription: A yellow with a whitish tint, like the color of an elephant's long front teeth.

jeoreoteut.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '저러하듯' (a conjugated form of '저러하다' (be like that)).

jeweler's.definitionKo: 보석이나 보석으로 만든 장신구를 사고파는 가게.
jeweler's.englishDescription: A shop where jewels or accessories made of jewels are sold and bought

juansang.englishDescription: table of drinks and snacks: A table set with drinks and food.

kickboard.definitionKo: 긴 손잡이가 있고, 납작한 바닥에 작은 바퀴가 달린 탈것. 두 손으로 손잡이를 잡고 바닥에 발을 올려 다른 한 발로 바닥을 밀면서 탄다.

traveling.definitionKo: 어떤 사실이나 소식을 알아내기 위해 사람이나 장소를 찾아감.
traveling.englishDescription: An act of visiting a place or a person to find out a certain fact or news.
An act of visiting a tourist attraction or historic site to look around.

twine.definitionKo: 어떤 물체를 다른 물체에 말거나 빙 두르다.
twine.englishDescription: To roll or wrap one object around another.

twine.definitionKo: 뱀 등이 자기의 몸을 둥글게 말거나 다른 물체를 빙빙 두르다.
twine.englishDescription: For a snake, etc., to coil or entwine itself around other objects.

twine.definitionKo: 실처럼 길고 가느다란 것을 여러 가닥 모아서 비비면서 감아서 하나의 줄로 만들다.
twine.englishDescription: To gather and twist several strips of something long and thin, such as thread to make one string.

twine.definitionKo: 어떤 물체를 다른 물체에 둘러서 감다.
twine.englishDescription: To roll or wrap one object around another.

twine.definitionKo: 덩굴이나 뱀 등이 그 몸으로 다른 것을 마구 둘러서 감다.
twine.englishDescription: For a snake or vine, etc., to coil or entwine itself wildly around other objects.

twine.definitionKo: 줄이 어지럽게 뒤섞임. 또는 그 줄.
twine.englishDescription: A state in which lines are mingled in a disorderly manner; or the lines.

unconditional.definitionKo: 사실을 옳게 보거나 판단하지 못한 채로 무조건 행동하는.
unconditional.englishDescription: Acting without viewing or judging a situation correctly.

unconditional.definitionKo: 아무런 조건이 없는. 또는 아무것도 따지지 않는.
unconditional.englishDescription: Having no conditions, or demanding nothing.

undervalue.englishDescription: To be set lower than actual price or value.

unfriendly.definitionKo: 태도, 말씨, 분위기가 부드럽지 않고 어색하거나 엄격하다.
unfriendly.englishDescription: A person's attitude, manner of speaking, image, etc., being awkward or stern, not soft.

unfriendly.definitionKo: 대하는 태도가 별로 친근하지 않고 무관심한 듯하다.
unfriendly.englishDescription: Treating someone in an unfriendly and indifferent manner.

unfriendly.definitionKo: 사람을 대하는 태도가 상냥하거나 부드럽지 않다.
unfriendly.englishDescription: An attitude toward someone being not gentle and nice.

unfriendly.definitionKo: 사이가 가깝지 않고 거리가 있어서 서먹서먹하다.
unfriendly.englishDescription: Being unfamiliar and on distant terms with each other .

unpretentious.definitionKo: 사람의 성질이나 태도가 꾸밈이나 거짓이 없고 까다롭지 않아 순하다.
unpretentious.englishDescription: One's personality or attitude being gentle, neither pretentious nor picky.

unusually.definitionKo: 상태나 성격, 행동 등이 보통과 아주 다르게.
unusually.englishDescription: In the manner of a state, one's personality, behavior, etc., being very uncommon.

white.englishDescription: The color of snow or milk.

white.definitionKo: 달걀노른자를 싸고 있는 달걀의 흰 부분.
white.englishDescription: The white part of an egg, which surrounds the yolk.
The color as white as snow.
The color of snow or milk.

white.definitionKo: 다른 색이 전혀 섞이지 않은 하얀색.
white.englishDescription: A white color that is not at all mixed with other colors.

white.definitionKo: 눈이나 우유의 빛깔과 같이 밝고 선명하게 희다.
white.englishDescription: Clearly bright, white like the color of snow or milk.

white.definitionKo: 춥거나 겁에 질려서 얼굴이 핏기가 없이 희다.
white.englishDescription: One's face turning white with cold or out of terror.
The moonlight being white and clear.
The color of snow or milk.

white.definitionKo: 춥거나 무서워서 얼굴이 핏기가 없이 아주 희다.
white.englishDescription: One's face turning very white with cold or out of terror.
Bright and clear like the color of snow or milk.

wishy-washy.definitionKo: 행동, 성격, 관계 등이 분명하지 않고 애매모호하다.
wishy-washy.englishDescription: Lacking certainty, being unclear in one's actions, personality, relationship, etc.

withering.englishDescription: A state in which the leaves of plants and trees wither away.
The state in which something contracts or gets smaller in volume as it dries or wilts.

yoreomyeon.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리하면' (a conjugated form of '요리하다' (do this way)).
An abbreviated word for '요러하면' (a conjugated form of '요러하다' (be this way)).
